notes: Norwegian ATS used by many kommuner (e.g. vestre-toten.easycruit.com). Each employer gets its own subdomain, but the form engine/field-numbering scheme is shared — this profile generalizes across all of them, do not recon from zero for a new *.easycruit.com vacancy. Guest-friendly: the 'Allerede registrert?' block is a collapsed OPTIONAL login section, not a mandatory gate — skip it and go straight to the application form. It is ONE long form (not a multi-page Next-wizard like recman) with repeatable 'add entry' subsections.

entryFlow.gotcha: id is prefixed with a per-vacancy number, e.g. '96_accepted_privacy_statement' — match by id suffix, not exact id

fieldNamingConvention: field_<sectionId>_<fieldNumber>, e.g. field_1_2 = first name. Section 1 = personalia (fixed, filled once). Sections 3/2/8/5/6/7 are repeatable (see repeatableSections below) and only exist after clicking their 'b_add_<sectionId>' button.

personaliaFields.label: Land
personaliaFields.gotcha: select by { label: 'Norge' }, not by value code

personaliaFields.label: Fylke
personaliaFields.gotcha: value codes are per-Norway-region, e.g. '10' = Innlandet; wait ~500ms after setting before the Kommune dropdown populates

personaliaFields.label: Kommune
personaliaFields.gotcha: options depend on Fylke selection above; wait ~1500ms for it to populate before selecting

personaliaFields.label: CV
personaliaFields.gotcha: after setInputFiles, an 'upload_button_field_1_22' button often appears and must be clicked to actually attach it — check for its presence and click if found

repeatableSections.name: Arbeidserfaring
repeatableSections.gotcha: add one entry per relevant job — call addButton+fill+saveButton in a loop, one full cycle per position, most-relevant/leadership roles first

fields.label: Klasse
fields.gotcha: value codes: '1' = Klasse B, '9' = Klasse E. One addEntry cycle per class held.

repeatableSections.name: Språk

fields.label: Språk
fields.gotcha: value codes: '222' Ukrainsk, '160' Norsk (bokmål), '177' Russisk, '224' Engelsk

repeatableSections.gotcha: for Norsk bokmål use level code '7' (God kjennskap) across all three, matching the B1-honest policy — never '3' (Morsmål) or a full-fluency code. See skills/application-pipeline for the B1 rule.

jobSpecificQuestionFields.note: field_<N>_<M> numbering for these is per-vacancy dynamic — always confirm via recon on the live page, do not assume the numbers from a past job.

examples.label: Norsk muntlig/skriftlig behersket?
examples.gotcha: select 'Delvis', never 'Ja' full — see B1 policy in skills/application-pipeline

submitButton.gotcha: the SAME button name is reused for every intermediate 'advance' click as well as the final submit — there is no separate 'Send søknad' selector. After the final click, verify success by checking the page did NOT redisplay the form with an error banner (selector: '.orangeBox, [class*="error"], [class*="Error"]'). If that banner element is present and the b_next button count is still > 0, the submit failed silently and must be treated as manual_review, not success.
